name: HoldingGrid
tagline: The track of HoldingCards (gh#1439): `view="grid"` lays tiles on `--editorial-holding-grid-track-size` (default four columns); `view="list"` turns the same cards into wide rows (`140px 1fr`, body on `1.5fr 1fr 140px`). A list (`ul`) of the cards.
usage: DO switch the view with an EditorialToggleGroup variant="icon"; never swap to a data table.
